title: Staples Canada print website breach, Nov 2026
disclaimer: Made for entertainment using AI. Not endorsed by Staples, any government agency, news outlet, company, or anyone else named.
size_basis: One print-ordering website in Canada. Staples has not said how many customers were affected.
who_is_affected: Customers of staplesprint.ca whom Staples emailed. Their names, emails, addresses, order summaries and encrypted passwords were involved. Staples says no financial information was.

known.text: An unknown party got into staplesprint.ca without permission and reached customer information.
The access happened between Nov 1 and Nov 5, 2026.
Names, emails, shipping and billing addresses, order summaries and encrypted passwords were involved.
Staples says no financial information was exposed.
Staples says it removed the intruder and secured all accounts.

not_known.text: Whether it has any link to the separate claim against Staples, Inc.
